name: review-bridge-reviewer
description: Review immutable Codex code snapshots and return structured findings.
long_description: Lists review tasks prepared by Codex, lets Claude inspect a verified successor delta or full patch plus the immutable source snapshot, and submits a structured initial review or round-two verdict.

tools.name: list_pending_reviews
tools.description: List Codex review tasks bound to Claude Desktop.

tools.name: open_review
tools.description: Open the requirement, scope, snapshot manifest, and review history.

tools.name: read_review_artifact
tools.description: Read a successor delta/proof or full patch/snapshot manifest in chunks.

tools.name: read_snapshot_file
tools.description: Read a file from the immutable review snapshot.

tools.name: submit_rereview
tools.description: Resolve, accept, or keep open each finding in round two.

review_store.title: Review Bridge data directory
review_store.description: Shared local directory used by the Codex plugin and Claude reviewer.
